_comment: COPY INTO SHOPIFY: Edit code -> config/settings_schema.json. Do NOT replace that file. Paste ONLY the object below (without this _comment key) as a new element of the top-level JSON array, e.g. right after the last group ('Customer accounts'). Mind the comma between array elements. The toggle then appears in Theme editor -> Theme settings -> 'Coming Soon mode'. `default: true` means Coming Soon mode is ON as soon as the schema is saved (campaign default from the handoff). Flip the checkbox off and Save to revert; the value is stored in config/settings_data.json.
name: Coming Soon mode

settings.content: Temporarily replaces Add to cart / Buy Now / accelerated checkout with a Coming Soon notice. MESSAGING ONLY: to actually block orders, set the product's inventory to 0 with 'Continue selling when out of stock' unchecked in Shopify Admin. See docs/COMING_SOON_DISABLE_ORDERS.md in the chillpod repo.

settings.label: Enable Coming Soon mode
settings.info: When on, buy buttons and dynamic checkout are hidden wherever the theme patches were applied. Turn off after inventory is restored.

settings.label: Optional note (leave empty to hide)
settings.default: We're not taking orders right now. Check back soon.
